div.div: 5 تخطّل فِى مِشْيَتِهِ He twisted himself in his gait, and walked with an elegant and a proud and self-conceited gait, with an affected inclining of the body from side to side. (K. [See also خَطَلٌ, an inf. n. of which the verb (خَطِلَ) is not mentioned as having this meaning.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
